new_issues.title: The dataset-edge gate reads the stored tick_dataset_edge, which only a tick pass refreshes, and runs before any pass, so a stale edge refuses the cutover with a misleading message.
new_issues.why: run_gates calls `mt data tick status --json`, whose edge comes from status_reads.dataset_edge (a SELECT on tick_dataset_edge). The row is written only by AvailabilityPhase.capture_dataset inside a tick pass, and mt-tick-pass has no timer. Both _estimate_only and _steps call run_gates before any pass, so an edge last observed before 2026-12-01 keeps check_dataset_edge refusing with 'the provider has not published it yet' even when it has. It fails closed (no spend), and an operator could unblock it by running `pass --estimate-only` by hand (that pass runs AvailabilityPhase), which the script does not say; whether the real operator flow does so before the cutover cannot be settled from code.
